SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r1.rating = r2.rating) AS same_rating_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r1.rating = r2.rating) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS same_rating_percent
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.reviews r1 ON r1.deal_id = d.deal_id AND r1.reviewer_role = 'buyer'
JOIN nlq.reviews r2 ON r2.deal_id = d.deal_id AND r2.reviewer_role = 'seller';
